title: Count Submatrices With All Ones
description: Given an `m x n` binary matrix `mat` containing only `0`s and `1`s, return the total number of non-empty rectangular submatrices whose elements are all `1`.
hints: Treat each row r as the bottom edge of a histogram where height[c] is the number of consecutive 1s ending at (r, c) moving upward.
Use a monotonic increasing stack of column indices along each row to compute, in O(n) time, the number of all-ones submatrices whose bottom-right corner is (r, c).

examples.explanation: There are 6 1x1, 2 1x2, 3 2x1, 1 2x2, and 1 3x1 all-ones submatrices, totaling 13.
Summing across all valid all-ones rectangles in the 3x4 grid yields 24.
A 1x1 matrix of [0] has 0 all-ones submatrices.
